parsed.notes:
WHAT YOU’LL NEED defaults to required; NICE TO HAVE is optional. Ideally makes the three programming languages optional.
Only candidate qualifications are labeled; company descriptions and responsibilities are excluded. Teaching, communication, community reputation, and event facilitation are treated as soft skills rather than taxonomy skills.
The coding-tool examples are treated as alternatives for the single AI-coding-tools ask, not as four independently mandatory tools.
Agent loops, tool calls, and model routers are explicitly alternatives, but only tool calling has a clear taxonomy match, so no singleton alternative group is emitted. Model routing is also requested optionally as multi-model routing.
Open-weight models are provisionally mapped to open-source-llms and flagged because open weights do not necessarily imply open-source licensing.
Debugging and terminal usage are read literally: neither implies Software Testing, Bash, or Linux. Sandboxing examples do not imply cybersecurity.
SDK and integration-template development are optional unmapped practices. Building example apps is not interpreted as a specific application-development stack.
